title: Hiring pipeline
label: A hiring pipeline as a kanban board with four columns: Applied, Screen, Interview and Offer, each showing how many candidates it holds. Candidate cards, each with the hiring lead's initials and the role, advance one stage at a time, until Amara Osei reaches Offer and her card turns into a green 'Offer accepted' chip.
heading:
Every candidate,
exactly where they stand.
sub: One board for the whole loop. Hiring leads see who is waiting on them, and nobody falls between stages.
